training_variants.sqlite_only: One SQLite target for every training intent (1227 rows).
training_variants.joint_balanced: One dialect-balanced target for every training intent (1227 rows).
training_variants.joint16_full: All 16 dialect targets for every training intent (19632 rows).

training.method: fp16 LoRA SFT with reduced GradScaler initial scale on V100

epoch_selection.criterion: First conservative point with both mean and tail training loss near 0.1; epochs 4-5 were treated as near-zero memorization rather than selected by minimum training loss.
